_provenance.notes: CU-324 refresh (2026-08-29). Results-affecting: the E_sky_thermal flux-diffusivity exponent D is no longer the CU-155 fitted 1.1 but the geometric sec 48.2 deg = 1.50030 -- the secant of the diffusivity angle every up-looking MODTRAN deck in its reference set was run at, so the emissivity weighting and the scoring geometry are now the same angle and D carries no free parameter. The sky's effective emissivity rises everywhere (up to sec/1.1 = 1.364x where the sky column is optically thin), so this eps = 0.95 target's Kirchhoff-reflected sky term rises with it: signal_e +0.32% (1259389.89 -> 1263426.85 e-), snr +0.16% (1122.18 -> 1123.97, signal-shot-limited so it moves as sqrt(signal)). Parity against the nine-rung measured downwelling ladder (H5 + P1-P8) improves: RMS |ln(model/MODTRAN)| 2.0776 -> 1.9233 over 9 rungs x 2 bands, 0.4167 -> 0.3087 over the tropospheric rungs alone. The retired D = 1.1 had been fitted against two ground-rooted decks six weeks before that ladder existed. | CU-321 refresh (2026-08-02). Results-affecting: the path-thermal term CU-224 added is now emitted at a HEIGHT-RESOLVED, spectrally resolved effective temperature T_eff(lambda) -- the temperature that makes the one-slab Kirchhoff form reproduce the layered formal solution of the column's own non-isothermal air -- instead of the single near-surface temperature of the column's lower endpoint. The total optical depth, and hence the emissivity 1 - tau, is untouched: only the altitude the emission is weighted at changes. For this 3.5-5.0 um nadir 8 km column the MWIR opacity is spread over the whole column rather than concentrated at the warm surface, so the path radiance falls: signal_e -13.2% (1450410.41 -> 1259389.89 e-), snr -6.8% (1204.28 -> 1122.18, signal-shot-limited so it moves as sqrt(signal)). Measured against the batch-2 MODTRAN direction pairs, the down-looking MWIR parity this fixes goes from 2.01/2.25/2.42x to 1.14/1.22/1.22x on the tall columns (O3/O4/O5) and LWIR from 1.33/1.35/1.43x to 1.06/1.06/1.09x; the up-looking MWIR falls further below unity because the retired warm bias had been cancelling part of the CU-161 region-flat spectral-shape deficit there. | CU-224 refresh (2026-08-02). Results-affecting: SimpleAtmosphere.evaluate's down-looking path radiance now carries the Kirchhoff thermal emission term (1 - tau)*B(lambda, T_eff) of the same column, alongside the single-scatter solar term it had before. Until now the down-looking side had NO emission at all while the up-looking segment evaluators did, so one column of air read in the two directions differed by three to four orders of magnitude; upwelling MWIR/LWIR path radiance is emission-dominated, not scatter-dominated. Anchored against the batch-2 O-block upwelling MODTRAN runs (O1-O5, each the direction partner of a delivered up-looking run on the identical column): band-mean model/MODTRAN thermal path radiance moves from 2e-3...3e-8 to 0.42-2.42 (MWIR 3-5 um) and 0.53-1.43 (LWIR 8-12 um), the same band the up-looking side already sits in. This 3.5-5.0 um nadir 8 km scene gains the whole 0-8 km column's MWIR emission: signal_e +53.5% (944766.14 -> 1450410.41 e-), snr +23.9% (971.93 -> 1204.28, signal-shot-limited so it tracks sqrt(signal)). | CU-267 refresh (2026-08-01). The calibrated gas-region table is no longer read as a step function: the (floor_od, k_h2o, b_h2o) coefficients are joined across each region edge by a C1 smoothstep ramp of half-width 0.02 um, so tau(lambda) is continuous and a band-mean tau no longer depends on the sampling grid. This 3.5-5.0 um band sits with both endpoints exactly on region edges (3.50 and 5.00 um), so the 0.02 um inboard half of each ramp lies inside the band and band-mean tau_up falls slightly: signal_e -1.22% (956457.32 -> 944766.14 e-), snr -0.61% (977.93 -> 971.93, signal-shot-limited so it moves as sqrt(signal)). Bands crossing no edge are bit-identical. | CU-155 refresh (2026-07-18). E_sky_thermal rebuilt: target-anchored emission temperature T(h_tgt + 200 m) with flux-diffusivity exponent D = 1.1 on the target->h_atm_top vertical column, fit to the real MODTRAN 6 up-looking H-runs (pre-fix the model evaluated T at 0.5*h_sensor, clamping the space column to 216.65 K: MWIR downwelling ~40x low). The eps=0.95 target's Kirchhoff-reflected sky term rises accordingly: signal_e +1.48% (936848 -> 950709 e-), snr +0.74% (967.85 -> 974.99). | CU-007 refresh (2026-04-27). Pre-CU-007 chain routed MWIR ε+T scenes to T1Thermal (pure-emit). Post-CU-007 routes them to T3Mixed (emit + Kirchhoff-reflected sky); ε=0.95 ⇒ ρ=0.05 lifts signal_e by ~5.5% (750264 → 791901 e-) and snr by 866 → 890 (signal-shot-limited regime). Hot-target opt-out lives at source.target.is_hot_target. Pre-CU-007 history: Stage 4 Option C (2026-04-19) dropped the legacy scalar L_background term (Decision #13/#15), lifting snr from 666.21 to 866.11.
